Source reservation survives processing; bank release only after engine completes both lane CRC/IDs and read/write buses idle. Results remain locked through display lease.
Display bank releases only after ID/bank/epoch/CRC/count/good validation, reader idle, FIFO empty, grant ACK and healthy actual bank-consumption edge; sticky fault quarantines a bad lease.

Runtime faults stop admission and preserve transaction epoch. Only coordinated reset across DDR/capture/FIFO/consumer resets it; PCLK watchdog is clock-presence only and cannot establish frame progress.

proposed_wrapper_wiring.clock_reset: Same clk and same active-low rst_n for both components; both reset synchronously on positive clk. No asynchronous local cancellation.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.clients: Wrapper c0/c1 AR(addr28,len4,valid,ready) and R(data256,valid,last,id4) connect unchanged to matching arbiter.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.command_direction: arbiter.araddr/arlen/arvalid directly to DDR raw AR; DDR arready directly to arbiter.arready. Tap the same public arvalid/arready into return_stage.arvalid/arready. No command gate, mux, withdrawal or new delay.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.return_direction: DDR rawR(data256,valid,last,id4) -> return_stage.in_* -> registered return_stage.out_* -> arbiter.rdata/rvalid/rlast/rid -> selected client.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.ready_valid: No RREADY at DDR, stage, or clients. Each client must reserve all burst-response storage before asserting ARVALID. ARLEN encodes beats-1,0..15 means1..16 beats.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.last_id: Data,last,id and valid are aligned by one register edge. Expected read RID=0 and RLAST at beat==ARLEN are checked by arbiter. Guard checks ownership before latency.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.first_beat_latency: Raw firstR may coincide with raw AR acceptance. Stage exposes it in the following clock cycle after that positive edge; arbiter READ owner then routes it. Subsequent contiguous beats remain1 per cycle, with exactly1 added clock for the complete return bundle.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.invalid_payload: Payload/last/id registers have no reset or enable mux and capture every edge. After reset only out_rvalid=0 is meaningful; invalid payload must be ignored.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.flush: No flush/abort input. Never synthesize flush by ORing fault into reset. Coordinated reset must include DDR,stage,arbiter and client transactions.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.fault_exports: Expose return_protocol_fault/return_fault_code separately from arbiter_failed/arbiter_fault_code; combined failed is OR only for parent admission/quarantine. A chosen combined fault-code priority is diagnostic policy, not permission to mask other cause.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.fault_detection_latency: protocol_fault is a positive-edge registered sticky flag, not a combinational raw-event veto at a parent release edge. Same-edge raw protocol failure versus parent lease release requires a fresh full-system review/test; this isolated unit proposal does not grant that acceptance.
proposed_wrapper_wiring.fault_command_invariant: Do not feed combined failed back into rst_n or any issued ARVALID/araddr/arlen/arready. Parent stops new admissions but retains accepted leases/storage until valid completion or coordinated epoch reset.

source_commit_contract.common_edge: On rising core_clk with src_valid && src_ready, source_commit<=1 and ID/bank/CRC/pixel fields latch together; default pulse clear on other cycles. NBA registered outputs represent the accepted descriptor in the following cycle, not an arbitrary input VS edge.
source_commit_contract.publish: All three assign result_publish=source_release, publish_id=active_process_id and publish_bank={1'b1,write_bank}; this is a different event from source_commit.
source_commit_contract.incompatible_fields: Published60 source_commit_bank/released_bank are2bits, canonical main/OP1bit. For logical source2 -> physical slot4, silently dropping the high bit aliases source0 and corrupts ownership. Widen the complete producer/link/bank/system/telemetry consumer chain or reject bank2 explicitly in an isolated adapter; no truncation.
source_commit_contract.op_parameter_boundary: OP system/bank/engine take gamma/correction plus17 Brown/rotation configuration fields; published60 bank/core frame-latch cfg_corrected and fixed C profile. Same metadata pulse does not make OP engine interchangeable.
